description: One named file, re-indexed (S30 T4 §3, D6): the incremental maintenance door — delete that file's rows, re-parse that file alone, and re-link the edges OTHER files held into it by symbol (re-resolution by name is a cross-file guess by construction, so re-linked edges arrive `inferred`). The counters are touched-rows for THIS file only: a reparse that reports the project's row count is a whole rebuild wearing an incremental costume. Files the grammar registry does not claim are skipped, not errored.
